note: The ecolog window («Науковий термінал», the Scientists' lab terminal): a light lab casing round a dark screen of four plates -- the header, a row of instruments showing the pool, the tree growing right with hexagonal sensors on a 24-unit grid, and at the bottom the node's protocol in five columns. Root TreeWindow fills the screen; TreeStage is the mockup's 1600x900 stage, centred. Roles the menu fills are listed in source/ui/SKINS.md; numbers are the mockup's, measured in Chrome on its own window (build/ui-ref/ecolog.png).

panel.name: TreeOutside
panel.note: Around the stage on screens wider than 16:9: the mockup page's ground.

panel.name: EcoCaseBg
panel.note: #stage: the inside of the casing between the plates (casing 40 % with #0b0b0a).

panel.name: EcoHeadPlate
panel.note: .ehead: title, device name; on the right the branch and its line.

panel.name: EcoTitleRow
panel.note: The title, then the device name 18 after it: lined up by the menu (FlowLater from the skin's OnShow) by the width of each TEXT -- the title is wider in Ukrainian than in English.

label.name: EcoTitle
label.note: Upper-cased and spaced by the skin (.title).

label.name: DevName
label.note: Upper-cased and spaced by the skin (.dev).

label.name: BranchName
label.note: Upper-cased by the skin (.bname); right-aligned to the plate's padding like the mockup.

icon.name: EcoBranchMark
icon.note: Not in the mockup (one branch per faction there): shown before the branch name when there are several.

raw.name: EcoBranchNext
raw.note: Several branches: a click on the branch name opens the next one (the skin sizes it to the text).

raw.name: BtnClose
raw.note: Not in the mockup (a browser page closes itself): a key in the header's free middle, its right edge 30 left of the wider branch line; the skin sizes it to its word and places it (OnUpdate).

panel.name: EcoReadPlate
panel.note: .readouts: the row of instruments showing the pool.

icon.name: EcoPoolLabel
icon.note: The vertical 'Бали' (.readouts .lab): a picture per language, the skin loads STR_OZL_SKIN_ECOLOG_POOL_VERTICAL_IMG into it.

panel.name: PoolList
panel.note: HIDDEN on purpose: the menu still creates one ozl_ecolog_pool_row per line here and hands each to PaintPoolRow (which lines, in which order), but the skin draws the line in its own instrument EcoPool<n> below. On the stand (2026-10-31) the engine handed this path another skin's file (OZL_DutyRegistryRow: SKINS.md, Layout mix-up); a row that is never shown cannot show the wrong widgets.

panel.name: EcoPools
panel.note: The pool as a row of instruments (.pool / .prow): the line's name in capitals (dim), its number big, its colour chip top-right -- no gauge (owner, 2026-10-31). Eight instruments; the skin fills one per line from PaintPoolRow and shares the width out equally, 10 apart (OnPaint).

panel.name: EcoTreeBox
panel.note: .tree: the tree on its 24-unit grid, the legend along its foot.

raw.name: TreeScroll
raw.note: The tree, growing right: drag it or the wheel. The menu sizes TreeContent. The bars: the thumb in cell-edge, the track at half of it (color + style blank, SKINS.md) -- the mockup's cell-edge thumb on the screen track.

image.name: TreeGlow
image.note: The glow of the tree's screen (.content .bg) with the screen under it, baked opaque (the engine blends in linear light: a 6 % light layer would come out several times brighter), stretched over the content: the gradient is relative to the box, so the stretch is exact.

panel.name: EcoTiers
panel.note: The tier labels 'тир I' (.tierlab) -- the skin's own, placed by it (OnPaint) on the tier's point, 22 from the top. No TreeTiers role: the engine's tier_label rows came back as another skin's file on the stand (OZL_DutyPriceChip, SKINS.md Layout mix-up).

raw.name: TreeLines
raw.note: The 24-unit grid and every link, drawn by the menu.

image.name: EcoFogStripes
image.note: The 135-degree stripes of the fog, a pixel tile: the skin lays them on TreeFogEdge's box, so they show only through the fade, as in the mockup.

label.name: TreeTipText
label.note: Wider than any tip on purpose: the menu sizes TreeTip from the text and TreeTip clips the rest.

panel.name: LegendRow
panel.note: Lined up by the menu (FlowLater from the skin's OnShow) by the width of each item's TEXT, 14 apart.

list.name: TreeTemplates

row.name: OZL_EcologOrLabel
row.note: The 'АБО' over an 'any' diamond (horizontal trees: centred 14 above it); the menu puts the row's corner on the diamond and colours the word like its line.

row.name: OZL_EcologPriceChip
row.note: One line of a node's price: its 7-unit square and the amount, 3 apart (.price b); the skin lines the chips up and centres them under the node.

row.name: OZL_EcologPoolRow
row.note: The row the menu creates per pool line into the HIDDEN PoolList: never shown -- the skin draws the line in its instrument EcoPool<n> (see PoolList). The menu's roles are here so the base hook finds them.

row.name: OZL_EcologCostRow
row.note: A cost line of the protocol (.crow): chip, name, 'have / need' right-aligned, a 3-unit bar under name and value; 8 under it are the column's gap.

row.name: OZL_EcologOpensChip
row.note: A node this one opens (.opens a): the word in a 1-unit frame, 8 + text + 8; a hidden node's chip ('??? невідомо') is faint in a dashed frame. The skin lines the chips up and sizes the frames.

raw.name: ChipHit
raw.note: style Empty: a style-less button paints a light box under the mouse.

list.note: Holds no rows: it only declares the row files the menu creates outside the lists.

panel.name: EcoCardPlate
panel.note: The bottom plate: the node's protocol.

frame.name: CardEmpty
frame.note: No node selected (.empty): the two lines centred in the first column, a 1-unit rule at the left of their block (the skin sizes the block to the hint, FitLater).

frame.name: CardBody
frame.note: .card: the protocol of the selected node in five columns 320 | rest | 330 | 300 | 230.

frame.name: EcoColHead
frame.note: Column 1 of the protocol (.c-head), clipped like the mockup's overflow: hidden.

stack.name: CardFlow
stack.note: Name (two lines), meta (three), status, 8 apart; the stack starts 2 above the mockup's line box so the Metron caps sit where the mockup's do.

stack.name: CardName
stack.note: Word-wrapped by the menu into its lines.

stack.name: CardMeta
stack.note: Word-wrapped by the menu into its lines.

panel.name: CardDesc
panel.note: Word-wrapped by the menu into its lines, 19.6 apart (line-height 1.4): a distance-field MultilineTextWidget would set them a font size apart, 14.

frame.name: EcoColCost
frame.note: Column 3 (.c-cost): cost lines, then the materials.

panel.name: EcoItemsHeadRow
panel.note: Shown and hidden with CardItemsHead (the skin follows the menu).

frame.name: EcoColTime
frame.note: Column 4 (.c-time): the duration or the running project with its 20 segments, then what the node opens -- in this column, the ecolog window has no column of its own for it.

panel.name: EcoTimeRow
panel.note: 'Тривалість: 1 хв 00 с' (CardTime), or while researching 'Лишилось' + the clock in bold + 'з 1 хв 00 с', placed by the skin.

frame.name: CardSegs
frame.note: The 20 segments of a running project (.pbar), 2 apart; 8 under them are the gap.

panel.name: EcoOpensHeadRow
panel.note: Shown and hidden with CardOpensHead (the skin follows the menu).

frame.name: CardOpensList
frame.note: The chips of the nodes this one opens; exact width, so the menu's flow can size it.

frame.name: EcoColFoot
frame.note: Column 5 (.c-foot): the button and the reason under it, held to the bottom (the skin lifts them when the reason takes two lines).

raw.name: BtnResearch
raw.note: style Empty: the skin draws the frame, the menu the hover.

panel.name: BtnResearchHover
panel.note: Under the mouse while enabled (.go:hover): acc fill, the word in the screen colour.

text.name: CardWhy
text.note: The reason the button is off (.why), wrapped by the engine: a distance-field font.

panel.name: EcoBezel
panel.note: #stage::before: the light lab casing over the whole window -- 10 of casing (outer corners rounded 6: the four corner pictures), a 2-unit highlight and the 10-unit dark rim the plates' edges run under. Last child, so it is drawn above the screen; a transparent panel, so the mouse goes through.
